column1: # Page lists as the user types them, and what reading them must give.
# Two readers go through every case and must agree: `parse_pages` of the
# One case per line, three fields separated by a tab:
#   1. what is typed, as it is, spaces included (nothing for an empty field);
#   2. how many pages the document has;
#   3. the pages read, numbered from 1, separated by commas; or `!`, a
#      space, then the refusal, word for word.
# Lines that start with `#`, and empty lines, are not cases.
# Both readers take a page as often as it is typed (`3,3`): a merge on the
# command line may. The window refuses it afterwards, for this ramp
